description: Recorded run setup and summarized results; historical paths identify original artifacts.

record.caveat: Client errors cover the recorded measurement cohort. Host counter deltas use interior intervals. Server counters and histograms cover entire runs including preparation/warmup; send completion does not imply peer receipt. Raw NIC counters can wrap. These are correlations, not per-request attribution.

record.status: Investigation complete; candidate remains isolated and is not applied to retained server source.
record.goal: active; every tie and residual failure remains open
record.measurement_scope: 12 GET runs; three rotated pairs per load; 20-second high-load measurements; original 2-second client deadline.

controlled_regression.caveat: Rule drops first six response packets. Baseline deadline expires after five transmissions; candidate completes after all six drops. Earlier non-reproducing calibrations are retained separately.

record.decision: Strong evidence for a configurable thin-stream retry policy as the first adoption candidate. It recovers sooner but does not prevent packet loss. Saturated throughput, median latency, CPU, and retransmission costs remain visible; no claim of universal or zero-error superiority.
unmeasured_candidates_ranked: Bounded aggregate response pacing/adaptive transport admission
Negotiate ECN with participating clients and paths
record.next_diagnostic: Capture bounded TCP_INFO and request-phase details on residual failures, with per-trial qdisc deltas.
